page_title: EMP 1-0 NAP | Empoli v Napoli 20/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+3' Booking. Cyril Ngonge (Napoli) receives a caution from the referee.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
90' Szymon Zurkowski (Empoli) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Gianluca Manganiello blows for a foul.
89' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
89' Francesco Calzona has decided to substitute Frank Anguissa and he is replaced by Giovanni Simeone (Napoli).
86' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
83' Elia Caprile displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Victor Osimhen (Napoli) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
82' Substitution. Liberato Cacace (Empoli) on for Giuseppe Pezzella.
82' Davide Nicola has decided to make a change. Simone Bastoni (Empoli) replaces Alberto Grassi.
80' A nice individual effort by Piotr Zielinski (Napoli) comes to nothing as his shot is blocked on the edge of the box by a defender.
78' Sebastiano Luperto (Empoli) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
77' The ball is out of play. Napoli will have a chance to score from a corner.
74' The ball is out of play. Napoli win a corner kick.
74' Youssef Maleh (Empoli) commits a rough foul. Gianluca Manganiello stops the game and makes a call. Napoli have a free kick.
72' Substitution. Matteo Politano is replaced by Cyril Ngonge (Napoli).
72' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia comes off the pitch to be replaced by Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli).
70' Davide Nicola decides to make a substitution. Jacopo Fazzini will be replaced by Szymon Zurkowski (Empoli).
69' It will be a substitution. Matteo Cancellieri (Empoli) is ready to enter the pitch as Nicolo Cambiaghi walks off.
68' Piotr Zielinski (Napoli) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.

67' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) goes on a mazy run, skips past two defenders and pulls the trigger in front of the keeper. Elia Caprile makes a great save to deny his effort directed under the crossbar. The ball goes behind for a corner. Napoli will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
67' The corner from Piotr Zielinski (Napoli) is intercepted by the defence.
66' Fine play by Matteo Politano (Napoli) opens up space on the edge of the box for the shot, but his effort lacks accuracy and flies miles over the bar.
66' Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli) is having a lively performance. He is causing problems and wanting the ball at every opportunity.
64' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
62' Pasquale Mazzocchi (Napoli) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
59' Elia Caprile reacts well to deny a long-range free kick from Matteo Politano (Napoli) towards the middle of the goal.
58' Bartosz Bereszynski (Empoli) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Gianluca Manganiello had an easy-decision to make.
57' The players claim that Frank Anguissa (Napoli) handled the ball and it seems they are right. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Empoli.
56' Gianluca Manganiello blows his whistle and signals a foul after Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) brought his opponent down. Empoli win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
55' A pass by Stanislav Lobotka (Napoli) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
54' Giuseppe Pezzella (Empoli) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
52' Napoli keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
50' The resulting corner from Piotr Zielinski (Napoli) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
50' Matteo Politano (Napoli) sees his long-range effort blocked. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Napoli.
49' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) sprays a pass out to Frank Anguissa, but he can't beat his man to get to the ball.
48' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Natan comes off for Pasquale Mazzocchi (Napoli).
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' Gianluca Manganiello blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) commits a foul after making a slide tackle on his opponent.
44' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
42' The percentage of ball possession is – 32:68.
39' An attempted cross from Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) is cleared.
37' Gianluca Manganiello shows a yellow card to Juan Jesus (Napoli) for his blatant foul.
35' A great pass puts Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) clear inside the box, he sidesteps the keeper but inexplicably hits his shot against the left post.
33' Piotr Zielinski (Napoli) trips an opposition player and Gianluca Manganiello signals a foul.
32' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.

31' The fans were almost celebrating as Victor Osimhen (Napoli) produced a shot from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo run. The ball was heading towards the middle of the goal, but Elia Caprile made an astonishing save!
29' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Victor Osimhen (Napoli), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat.
27' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) makes his forward run a little too early and is caught in an offside position after his teammate tries to play a pass to him.
25' Youssef Maleh (Empoli) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
25' Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. Empoli win a corner.

24' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) cuts inside his marker and unleashes a rocket of a shot from inside the box. The ball flies towards the bottom right corner, but it's kept out by magnificent save from Elia Caprile.
23' The corner from Matteo Politano (Napoli) is cleared away by the defence.
20' Davide Nicola is forced to make a change. Alberto Cerri is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by M'Baye Niang (Empoli).
19' Alberto Cerri (Empoli) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
19' Napoli failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
18' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) sends a low pass into the box, towards Victor Osimhen. However, he takes one touch too many and loses it to one of the defenders.
16' Youssef Maleh (Empoli) whips in a cross from the corner, but Alex Meret is well positioned and punches the ball away.
14' Some great controlled play and passing from Napoli. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
12' Juan Jesus (Napoli) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. Empoli have a free kick from a promising distance.
11' Youssef Maleh (Empoli) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Gianluca Manganiello blows his whistle for a foul.
10' The ball is cleared after Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
8' PENALTY APPEAL after Alberto Cerri (Empoli) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
7' Alberto Cerri (Empoli) picks up a long through ball, but Alex Meret deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
6' A cross into the box from Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) is cleared.

4' 1 - 0 Emmanuel Gyasi produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box, where Alberto Cerri (Empoli) rises high to head the ball into the left side of the goal and beyond the goalkeeper. He makes it 1:0.

2' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Empoli will take the kick-off.
